results.content:
HMG Metaplant America

HMG Metaplant America

# About Us

Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America (HMGMA) is Hyundai Motor Group’s newest auto manufacturing facility and is located in southeast Georgia, about 30 miles west of downtown Savannah.

Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America’s story began in May 2022 when Hyundai Motor Group entered into an agreement with the State of Georgia to build its first dedicated fully electrified vehicle and battery manufacturing facilities in the United States. [...] The Metaplant is the centerpiece of a larger automotive ecosystem that stretches across the megasite. In addition to HMGMA, the campus includes HLBMA, a joint venture battery manufacturing plant, and five key affiliates: Hyundai Mobis, Hyundai Glovis, Hyundai Transys, Hyundai Steel, and Hyundai Material. Another 22 suppliers operate nearby, creating an integrated network that supports vehicle production from battery manufacturing to final assembly. [...] Sustainability is another cornerstone of the Metaplant’s operations. HMGMA utilizes XCIENT heavy-duty hydrogen fuel-cell electric trucks to transport vehicle parts from suppliers across the region each day. This industry-leading initiative reduces emissions while supporting cleaner logistics operations throughout the supply chain.
